title: Optimizing Distributed Microservice Latency
business: E-commerce platforms managing high-volume transaction flows across distributed microservices.
problem: Unidentified latency spikes in cross-service communication lead to abandoned shopping carts and inconsistent user experiences.
solution: Azure Application Insights provides end-to-end distributed tracing and dependency mapping to visualize request flow and pinpoint performance bottlenecks in downstream service calls.
steps: Instrument the application code with the Application Insights SDK to enable telemetry collection.
Configure the connection string in the application environment variables to link telemetry to the Azure resource.
Deploy the application to the target environment to begin capturing request and dependency data.
Use the Application Map in the Azure portal to identify slow dependency calls between services.
Analyze transaction details to correlate specific user requests with failed or slow downstream operations.
outcome: Improved visibility into service-to-service communication, enabling rapid identification and resolution of performance bottlenecks.
limitation: High-volume telemetry ingestion can lead to increased data storage costs; check this by monitoring the daily data volume and adjusting sampling rates in the SDK configuration.
